sense: to no longer move or do something

pins.definition: To cease moving or doing an ongoing activity, or to make someone or something stop moving.
To cease moving or bring a movement or activity to an end.
To cease moving or to pause during an activity.

situation: A crossing guard in a high-visibility vest stands in the middle of a zebra crossing, one hand raised palm outwards towards oncoming cars and the other holding a round red stop paddle with no marks on it, while a car has come to a halt right in front of him and children wait safely on the pavement. His raised palm and the stopped car are the clear focus.
subject: a guard stopping traffic with a raised hand
